messages:
sylvia: setting up redwood-dedicated-eu-west3 project for Dedicated trial. Need help with VPC layout, Private Service Connect endpoints, and quota increases for A100 GPUs.

devon: how many GPUs initially?

sylvia: starting 8 A100s (a2), ramp to 24 within 30 days. plan: separate VPC per customer but host PSC endpoints in a shared-services project for model ingress.

mira: heads up: eu-west3 accelerator quotas are small by default. File a quota request for accelerators (a2), regional CPU quota, and for internal addresses if using PSC.

sylvia: GCP support asked for an architecture diagram and autoscale profile. what's a safe subnet plan for 24 GPUs + k8s pods?

devon: recommend worker subnet /22 to allow plenty of pod IPs. example layout: 

worker-subnet 10.40.0.0/22
infra-subnet 10.40.4.0/24
svc-subnet 10.40.5.0/24

avoid customer ranges; use our reserved RFC1918 block.

sam: note GCP VPC peering slots are limited per region. PSC avoids peering but consumes internal IPs and internal forwarding rules. Also need reserved internal IPs for PSC endpoints and internal forwarding rules for the forwarders.

mira: explicitly request these quotas in the case: accelerator quota for a2 to 24, regional vCPU increase to support a2 machine types, internal IPv4 addresses (reserved) +4, internal forwarding rules +6, and regional static internal IP quota for NAT egress. Mention that predictable egress IPs are required for customer allowlists.

sylvia: can someone draft the support case text?

devon: draft (pasteable):

PROJECT: redwood-dedicated-euw3
REQUEST: quota increases needed to run Dedicated proof-of-load
- accelerate.googleapis.com/a2 (A100 GPUs): target limit 24
- Compute Engine regional CPUs: increase to support selected a2 machine types
- Internal IPv4 addresses (reserved): +4
- Internal forwarding rules: +6
- Regional static internal IPs for NAT egress: +4

ARCHITECTURE: Dedicated VPCs for customers, PSC endpoints hosted in shared-services project to expose inference services. Using PSC to avoid CIDR overlap and VPC peering limits. Autoscaling: node pool gpu-main min 2 max 16; node pool gpu-burst min 0 max 8; initial target capacity 8 nodes for load testing, expected ramp to 24 nodes within 30 days. Traffic egress will use shared NAT gateways with predictable egress IPs for customer allowlisting.

TIMING: load tests scheduled in 9 business days, please expedite.

mira: looks good. attach topology diagram and a short traffic profile (mostly steady with short spikes) when you file.

ops-bot: FYI current project has 2 VPC peering slots left in eu-west3.

gcp-quota-bot: Support case 879418002 opened for the requested quota changes. Estimated response 3-4 business days.

sam: cost note — 24 x A100s ~60k/mo raw compute. Static internal IPs and forwarding rules cost is negligible, but finance should ack for committed test spend.

sylvia: looping in finance and networking. I'll prepare Terraform for PSC in shared-services and pre-allocate IP ranges. Will post updates in this thread when case moves.
